pois.name: Φάρος Αγίων Θεοδώρων
pois.intro: Le phare d'Argostóli ou phare Saints-Théodore ou phare Agíon Theodóron ou phare d’Ágii Theódori est un phare maritime pittoresque de 1829, de style néo-classique grecque, de l'île de Céphalonie de l'archipel des îles Ioniennes de la mer Ionienne en Grèce.

pois.name: Αρχαία Κράνη
pois.intro: Cranii or Kranioi or Krane was a Greek city on the island of Cephallenia, situated at the head of a bay on the western coast. It was one of the four city-states that existed in the island together with Pale, Pronnoi and Same.

pois.name: Κοργιαλένειο Ιστορικό και Λαογραφικό Μουσείο Αργοστολίου
pois.nameEnglish: Korgialeneio Historic and Folklore Museum of Argostoli
pois.intro: The Argostoli Public Library, also known as the Korgialenios Library, is a Greek public library in Argostoli, Kefalonia. The library shares the same building as the Korgialenio History and Folklore Museum.

pois.name: Αρχαιολογικό Μουσείο Αργοστολίου
pois.intro: The Archaeological Museum of Argostoli, also known as the Kefalonia Museum, is a museum in Argostoli, Greece, located a few blocks south of the central square, across the Municipal Theater on R. Vergoti Street. The old museum was destroyed by an earthquake in 1953.

pois.name: Κάστρο Αγίου Γεωργίου Κεφαλονιάς
pois.intro: The Castle of Saint George, Castle of Cephalonia, or simply Kastro was a fortified settlement that was the main town of the island of Cephalonia, Greece, from the Middle Ages until the 18th century. The site is currently located near Peratata.

pois.name: Μυκηναϊκό Νεκροταφείο Μαζαρακάτων
pois.intro: Το μυκηναϊκό νεκροταφείο Μαζαρακάτων είναι αρχαιολογικός χώρος βρίσκεται 500 μέτρα νοτιοανατολικά του οικισμού των Μαζαρακάτων, περίπου 10 χλμ. ανατολικά της πρωτεύουσας του νησιού, το Αργοστόλι.

pois.name: The Ecclesiastical and Byzantine Museum of Cephalonia
pois.nameEnglish: The Ecclesiastical and Byzantine Museum of Cephalonia

pois.name: Ξι
pois.intro: Xi Beach is situated in the south of the Paliki peninsula of Kefalonia, Greece, and part of the district Mantzavinata near the town of Lixouri. Its reddish sand and clay cliffs shaped by the nature, make it truly unique.
